findings.body: The standard requires: "Touch only what the task needs." This repairs the unrelated close-test picker's lock-file fixture. The selected base already contains the same semantic lock comparison in src/forge/fasttest.py:112–158 and 175–180; this branch changes only its core budget. Consequently, the comment-only fixture was already incompatible with that existing behavior, rather than broken by agent lanes. The handoff explains preserving the full-suite assertion but establishes no dependency on this task. Move this test repair into a separate change.
findings.title: Standard: Touch only what the task needs

findings.body: The retained PR checker still launches Autoreview without process-group options, as verified at tests/fixtures/pr-check-before-branch-diff/review.py:531–533. This stop path nevertheless requests group termination for that child. src/forge/codex.py:624–631 signals and checks a group named by the child's pid, which does not exist for these launches; the child remains alive and stop refuses without freeing its place. Older Claude workers and readers have the same mismatch. Retaining the old signatures remains valid, but cancellation also needs to handle those ungrouped launches safely. The existing-queue test starts a newly grouped worker before converting its record, so it does not cover this case.
findings.title: Handle existing agents without a dedicated process group

findings.body: Review admission snapshots chosen here, but Autoreview defaults and unavailable-model fallback update only selected at src/forge/review.py:570–576. The running review's board entry therefore continues reporting null or the unavailable model. Split design workers likewise replace chosen when falling back to Codex at src/forge/worker.py:167–191 without refreshing their lane entry. Update the active entry's model and effort whenever either caller changes its selection.
findings.title: Refresh lane metadata when the selected model changes

findings.body: Actual test commands still bypass the shared entries: src/forge/fasttest.py:222–223 launches directly, while close uses the separate ticket queue at src/forge/review.py:279–288. The board consequently cannot expose their output or progress, and stop cannot cancel tests or end an item's worker and test together. plans/FORGE-LANES-1.md:142 assigns this integration and its command-level checks to TESTS, so it remains deferred advice rather than an AGENTS blocker.
findings.title: Later: connect test entries and cancellation in TESTS

stop.done: src/forge/machine.py is simpler and behaves as it did before
stop.reason: Owner accepted the finding; the worker had already reverted the unrelated lockfile test change at 12:11, so the part now leaves that test alone. Close again for a fresh review.
